name: Capu Mania
summary:
Capu Mania is a fast-paced movement-based multiplayer game inspired by the tag-style locomotion you love. Swing, climb, and outplay other players across unique custom maps designed for nonstop fun.

Join a growing community, unlock tons of awesome cosmetics, and express your style while competing with friends.

With frequent updates, fresh content, and exciting seasonal drops, there’s always something new to explore.

Jump in and start moving!
